pull_request.title: feat: ship a pinned devcontainer and container image for the nightly + dylint toolchain
pull_request.body:
## Closes #105
## Summary

This PR adds a pinned development container and Docker image to provide a consistent development environment for contributors working on the nightly + Dylint toolchain.

### Changes

* Added a `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` that opens into a fully configured development environment.
* Added a `Dockerfile` that uses the project's existing toolchain source of truth to pin the required nightly version.
* Preinstalled `cargo-dylint` and `dylint-link` in the container image.
* Added CI to build and publish the container image whenever the Dockerfile or toolchain pin changes.
* Added a CI job to build the image and run the UI test suite inside the container.
* Updated the documentation to recommend using the development container as the preferred setup for contributors.

### Notes

* The nightly toolchain is sourced from the existing project configuration to avoid introducing another hardcoded version.
* Image size was considered during implementation to help keep download times and storage requirements reasonable.
* Existing CI workflows remain unchanged, with only the additional container image workflow introduced.

### Testing

* `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
* `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`
* `cargo test --workspace`

commits.message:
feat: ship a pinned devcontainer and container image for the nightly + dylint toolchain

Add a Dockerfile and .devcontainer/devcontainer.json that provide a
zero-setup development environment with the exact nightly toolchain,
compiler components (rustc-dev, llvm-tools-preview), and Dylint
binaries (cargo-dylint, dylint-link ^6.0.1) preinstalled.

The Dockerfile reads the nightly channel from ^Grust-toolchain^G at build
time using the same strict regex as ^Gvalidate-toolchain-pins.sh^G — no
fifth hardcoded copy of the nightly string.

Size optimizations:
- ^G--profile minimal^G at rustup install time (no docs)
- ^G--no-install-recommends^G for apt packages
- cargo registry cache and git checkouts removed after install

CI changes:
- ^Gcontainer-test^G job (lint.yml): builds the image and runs
  ^Gcargo test --workspace^G inside it on every PR/push
- ^Gcontainer-publish.yml^G (new workflow): builds and pushes the image
  to GHCR on push to main, triggered only by changes to
  ^GDockerfile^G, ^Grust-toolchain^G, or the workflow itself

Docs:
- CONTRIBUTING.md: dev container documented as recommended setup
- README.md: quick-start pointer to the container image

Closes #105
